name: asdf
description: ASDF (Automated Software Development Workflow): runs the HLD, plan, TDD, review, PR and merge cycle against Azure DevOps work items, with the steering automated.
postInstallMessage: In a terminal, from the ASDF plugin directory, run node asdf.js --init. The numbered wizard configures local context, checkouts and project/team watches; it does not log in or contact Azure DevOps.
